## Purpose

This is a public notice to **Max Qian / AstroAir** and any other Night Owl rights holder or former maintainer.

The former upstream, <https://github.com/AstroAir/obsidian-night-owl>, and its owner account are currently unavailable. Night Owl was [re-added to Obsidian's official registry](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/commit/1db214b403e45929754f63b52a41ef9e5c333c92) under Max Qian/AstroAir and was later [removed in an automated registry update](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/commit/b80a2193798619da5531a21885e071ff3ffb0c0d).

This repository preserves the exact `manifest.json` and `theme.css` recovered from an existing Night Owl 1.0.0 installation. The recovered CSS has not been changed. Full source, hash, attribution, and license-evidence details are in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/mspirek/obsidian-night-owl/blob/main/NOTICE.md).

## Invitation to respond

If you are the original maintainer or another rights holder, please comment here if you want to:

- reclaim or transfer the project;
- request removal or another change to this preservation copy;
- approve continued community maintenance;
- provide the deleted repository's exact license notice; or
- correct any provenance or attribution detail.

This issue will remain open for at least 30 days. **September 9, 2026 is the earliest date on which an Obsidian Community directory request will be considered.** No directory request will be made before then.

Any response and the resulting maintenance decision will be documented publicly here. Thank you.
